brand.name: Rawhide Fire Hose
about: Rawhide Fire Hose is headquartered in Wooster, Ohio, and ships fire hose from four warehouses.
The name comes from the original fire hose, made from leather tubing that was tough yet flexible.

products.name: 1" Lightweight Booster Reel Hose (600 LB Test)
products.summary: Thin-walled, polyurethane lined booster hose with a helical reinforcement that holds its shape. Can be charged on the reel. Built for 12" drum reels and skid units.
details: This thin-walled polyurethane lined hose is the most durable lightweight booster hose on the market and is designed so that it can be charged with water, while still on the reel, making it ideal for close quarters uses. This lightweight 1 inch hose reel (600 LB Test) is a multi-purpose, lightweight, attack hose that meets the needs of industrial, municipal and forestry applications.
This uniquely constructed booster reel hose features an all-polyester cover for heat and abrasion resistance, along with a special helical interior reinforcement to retain its rigid shape.

Booster Hose Design: Circular woven, single jacket, combined with a helical interior reinforcement, and a polyester cover. Standard lengths are available up to 200 feet long. Custom lengths are available upon request.
Abrasion Impregnation: A polyurethane based polymer impregnation results in a red color and aids in abrasion resistance.
features: Colors: Red
Coupling options: Aluminum field attachable NPSH/IPT; Aluminum field attachable NST/NH; uncoupled
Single jacket construction
Rigid helical reinforcement
Lightweight and kink resistant
Abrasion resistant red cover
Designed for 12" drum reels and skid units
Diameter: 1"
Tube: Extruded polyurethane liner yields ozone and chemical resistance and extended shelf and use life.
Booster Hose Couplings: Field replaceable coupling with a one-inch NH or NPSH thread.

products.name: 1" Single Jacket Fire Hose (500 LB Test)
products.summary: Single jacket polyester fire hose with an EPDM lining, treated to resist mold and mildew. 250 psi service test, 500 psi proof test.
details: This quality fire hose is engineered to be abrasion resistant and impervious to mold / mildew for heavy-duty usage. This fire hose is designed to be easily deployed. It is built for prolonged storage and offers extended service life. All fire hose products provided by Rawhide Fire Hose meet or exceed NFPA 1961 standards. Note: All hoses should be inspected and tested per NFPA 1962 guidelines, provided the application falls under this jurisdiction.

Jacket Construction: This Single Jacket Fire Hose (500 LB Test) is comprised of a single jacket, woven evenly and free of defects, from spun polyester yarn offering superior strength and wear characteristics. The warp yarn is standard 100% polyester. The filler yarns are high strength, low elongation, filament type polyester, in order to reduce weight while increasing flexibility. In addition the jacket is processed with a treatment that helps to resist mold and mildew. This fire hose is available in white, red or yellow, as standard, with other colors available upon request. Standard lengths include 50' and 100'. This fire hose can be coupled with anodized aluminum (Threaded or Storz), brass threaded or camlock shanks.

Lining: The rubber lining is a single ply, extruded, synthetic EPDM tube, compounded to resist ozone. The manufacturing process includes a vulcanization phase that bonds the lining to the outer jacket.

Couplings: As required per specification(s). Available with internal expansion ring threaded aluminum couplings, NH/NST or NPSH/IPT. Storz, shank or cam-lock couplings or special threaded couplings are available upon request.
Special Characteristics: Lightweight and easy to handle. Wear and length of service can be extended by maintaining fire hose assemblies.
features: Colors: Red, White, Yellow
Lengths: 50, 100 ft
Coupling options: Aluminum IPT/NPSH (rocker lug, expansion ring); Aluminum NST/NH (rocker lug, expansion ring); uncoupled
Pressure Ratings: 250# Service Test Pressure; 500# Proof Test Pressure; 750# Burst Pressure
Temperature Range: -40 degrees F to 180 degrees F; -40 degrees C to 82 degrees C

products.name: 1-3/4" Double Jacket Fire Hose (800 LB Test)
products.summary: Double jacket polyester attack hose with an EPDM lining, made to municipal requirements. 400 psi service test, 800 psi proof test, 1350 psi burst.
details: The double jacket fire hose (800 lb test) is flexible, strong and abrasion resistant. Manufactured to exacting municipal requirements. Designed to be the ultimate in industrial and municipal fire protection.

Jacket Construction: The jackets are woven evenly and free of defects, from spun polyester yarn that offers superior strength and wear characteristics. The warp yarn is standard 100% polyester. The filler yarns are high strength, low elongation, filament polyester to reduce weight and increase flexibility. In addition the jacket is treated to resist mold and mildew.
Lining: The rubber lining is a single ply, extruded, synthetic EPDM tube, compounded to resist ozone. Under this specification, the construction of this hose is to be manufactured fully backed.
Couplings: As required per specification(s). Available with internal expansion ring threaded aluminum or brass.

Special Characteristics: Standard color is white. Available in yellow, red, orange, blue, black, tan and green. Standard lengths are 50' and 100'. Custom lengths are available. Hose meets the standards and specifications of Underwriters Laboratories, Inc. (UL), including UL-19 (tensile strength & elongation) for rubber-lined hoses. All hoses are stenciled with 1" characters stating "service test to 400 PSI Per NFPA 1962 " and the service date in a contrasting color indelible ink.
Service Life: This hose has a potential service life of ten (10) years, notwithstanding mistreatment and/or misuse.

products.name: 2" Rubber Covered Fire Hose (500 LB Test)
products.summary: Thru-the-weave nitrile rubber covered fire hose made to NFPA 1961. Resists ozone, oxidation, and most chemical and petroleum products. 500 psi acceptance test.
details: The rubber covered fire hose is manufactured to meet or exceed NFPA standard 1961, engineered to be durable and designed to remain flexible. Built to resist ozone, oxidation and most chemical / petroleum products. Made tough for extended service in rigorous use, yet virtually maintenance free.

Hose Construction: The rubber covered fire hose is constructed from 100% synthetic yarn combined with nitrile rubber. Thru-the-weave manufacturing utilizes a circularly woven frame that is completely locked in with tough nitrile rubber to produce a single homogeneous unit. The laminated process consists of a 3-ply system, independently extruded and double vulcanized for maximum durability. The longitudinal ribbing reduces drag and provides for long service. The twill weave of the reinforcement resists puncture.

Lining Properties: The tensile strength is 1500 PSI or greater, ultimate elongation is 400% minimum and the smooth nitrile rubber yields durability while minimizing pressure drop. This hose remains flexible down to 35 degrees F and will resist heat up to 1200 degrees F for two minutes without rupture or damage to the synthetic reinforcement.
Ozone Resistance: Hose shall show no visible signs of cracking to the lining or cover when tested in accordance to ASTM D518 Procedure B (100pphm/118°F/70 hours).

Chemical Resistance: Exposure to sea water and contamination by most chemical substances, hydrocarbons, oils, alkalis, acids and greases must have no effect on the short or long term performance of the hose. A chemical resistance chart is available and Key Hose will supply specific chemical resistance data on request of purchaser for unique applications.

Heat Resistance: The hose, when subjected to a static pressure of 100 PSI, shall be capable of withstanding a surface temperature of 1200°F for a minimum of one minute without rupture or damage to the synthetic reinforcement.
Special Characteristics: Manufactured to meet or exceed NFPA specifications. All hose markings are per NFPA requirements.

Pressure Ratings: 500# Acceptance Test Pressure; 250# Working Pressure; 750# Burst Pressure
Temperature Range: -4 degrees F to 212 degrees F; -20 degrees C to 100 degrees C

products.name: 1" Forestry Hose Type 2 (600 LB Test)
products.summary: Yellow single jacket forestry hose with a polyurethane lining, impregnated for abrasion resistance to USDA 5100-187. 900 psi minimum burst per NFPA 1961.
details: Jacket Construction: The jackets will be woven evenly and be free of defects, including knots, lumps, or unsightly disfigurations that could jeopardize the integrity of the hose assembly. The warp yarn shall consist of ring spun polyester yarn. The use of filament or entangled yarn is expressly forbidden due to the lack of inherent abrasion resistance. The filler yarns shall be constructed of high strength, low elongation, filament polyester to reduce weight and increase flexibility. The jacket construction shall be a 1-2 woven twill pattern with the 2 over-crossing on the exterior of the jacket.

Abrasion Impregnation: Hose assemblies are available with polymer impregnation that provide additional abrasion resistance. Standard color: yellow. Color shall be pure and even in each hose. Impregnated hose shall meet the requirements of USDA 5100-187 for abrasion resistance.

Lining: The lining shall be a single-ply extruded tube of synthetic polyurethane to resist ozone. The polyurethane tube shall adhere to the jacket to prevent delamination. The finished product will meet and exceed all potable water Mil-H-24606B standards for the manufacturing of lightweight fire hose. The use of the polyurethane lined fire hose is designed to increase packing ability and applications where lightweight fire hose is desired.

products.summary: Thru-the-weave nitrile rubber covered fire hose made to NFPA 1961. Resists ozone, oxidation, and most chemical and petroleum products. 600 psi acceptance test.
details: Our 1-3/4 inch fire hose is manufactured to meet or exceed NFPA 1961, engineered for durability and designed to remain flexible. It is built to resist ozone, oxidation and most chemical and petroleum products. This hose is made tough for extended service in rigorous use, yet is virtually maintenance-free.

Hose Construction: Our rubber covered fire hose is constructed from 100% synthetic yarn combined with nitrile rubber. Thru-the-weave manufacturing utilizes a circularly woven frame that is completely locked in with tough nitrile rubber to produce a single homogeneous unit. The laminated process consists of a 3-ply system, independently extruded and double vulcanized In both constructions, longitudinal ribbing reduces drag as the hose is advanced and extends service life, while the twill weave of the reinforcement resists puncture.

Lining Properties: The lining has a tensile strength of 1500 PSI or greater, and a minimum ultimate elongation of 400%. Its smooth nitrile rubber surface provides durability while minimizing pressure drop. This hose remains flexible down to 35 degrees F and will resist heat up to 1200 degrees F for two minutes without rupture or damage to the synthetic reinforcement.
Ozone Resistance: The hose shows no visible signs of cracking in the lining or cover when tested in accordance with ASTM D518 Procedure B (100pphm/118°F/70 hours).

Chemical Resistance: This hose is built to withstand exposure to seawater and contact with most chemical substances, hydrocarbons, oils, alkalis, acids and greases without affecting short- or long-term performance. A chemical resistance chart is available, and Rawhide will supply specific chemical resistance data on request for unique applications.

Heat Resistance: When subjected to a static pressure of 100 PSI, the hose can withstand a surface temperature of 1200°F for a minimum of one minute without rupture or damage to the synthetic reinforcement.
Special Characteristics: Manufactured to meet or exceed NFPA specifications. All hose markings are per NFPA requirements.
